fields.name: contentSpacing
fields.label: Stat Content Spacing
fields.description: Adds space between each item image, top label, stat value, stat label, and optional button. This does not change horizontal or vertical alignment.

fields.name: paddingStyle
fields.label: Padding Style
fields.description: Padding around the content inside the card (heading, body, stat list). Defaults to 15px on all sides. Not related to Stat Content Spacing, which only affects spacing between each item's own image/label/value/button.
